description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'MembershipTableSnapshot' in the Orleans runtime. It manages snapshots of cluster membership state, including versioning, entries, status retrieval, and comparison functionalities. The class handles updating snapshots and preserving certain membership attributes like IAmAliveTime.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the membership table in Orleans, including version, entries, and methods for updating, querying, and comparing snapshots.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new snapshot from membership table data.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the snapshot based on previous snapshot and new table data or snapshot.

methods.name: PreserveIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Ensures the maximum IAmAliveTime is retained during updates to prevent torn reads.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specified silo address.

methods.name: IsSuccessorTo
methods.description: Determines if the current snapshot is a successor to another snapshot based on version and entry states.
